watches.description: 7 years ago we built Jack his first Mission Timer. It launched the partnership — and we've been building custom limited-editions together ever since. Now it is time to get wet & sandy with this original CARR DIVER-1, created in CERAKOTE tan with a hand-regulated, custom etched, Swiss automatic: the same lines, now with a mechanical heart beating inside. 10 built, 10 sold — then it's history. Each of these timers was hand-crafted by ARES and features an ETA automatic movement, 1000M depth rating, and hand-regulation at +6/-4 COSC spec. You will receive the timer in a custom designed 4-slot watch roll, hand-crafted for this release by ESSTAC, in your personalized Seahorse packaging. All timers from the collection are handled as 1-Off customs. These ARES Mission Timers™ are Guaranteed for Life and subject to ARES Custom Warranty & Return Policy.

Two timezones. Certified to 100BAR. Serialized to you. Guaranteed for life. Want to know who builds it? ↓ Overbuilt. Underwater. Unapologetically American. The DIVER-1 GMT is the 1000M DIVER-1 platform with a second timezone added — a true Swiss GMT that tracks home while you read local. Same overbuilt case, same hand-built process, one more hand on the dial. From your initial order to final in-house packaging, your DIVER-1 GMT is purpose-built for you — not pulled from a shelf. Once you place your order, your watchmaker begins the build process by hand, every step of the way. Every DIVER-1 GMT is machined by local craftsmen a mile away to our spec, then assembled, regulated, and tested by hand by our six-person team. Nothing is overlooked. Nothing is rushed. Because we offer a few distinct models and build in limited batches, we strive to maintain small-batch inventory on hand. But in most cases, your watch will be made to order. While every effort is made to shorten your custom Swiss automatic timer's build time, manufacturing can take up to 6-8 weeks depending on complexity. It's built for you, the wait is worth it. This is not a stock item. It's a purpose-built instrument , assembled from scratch and engineered for a lifetime of hard use. Guaranteed for life. Two timezones, one dial. The GMT hand makes a single turn every 24 hours. Set it to home, read local on the main hands, and a glance tells you what time it is where you left — no bezel math, no guesswork. Built for the people who cross zones and still have to be on time in both. When You Order: - If your DIVER-1 GMT is in stock, it ships immediately. - If not, your order reserves a spot in the current production run — and we get to work. - You'll receive updates as your build progresses from steel to seal. watches.name: ARES 2026 Founder Build Experience
watches.description: Remember when you used to make things? We never stopped. Most people buy a watch. Almost nobody builds one. The ARES Founder Build Experience is the only place in American watchmaking where you can cut your own steel, finish your own case, personalize your own dial, assemble your own movement, engrave your own case back, and walk out wearing the Mission Timer you made. Because a watch you build isn’t just a watch. It’s proof you were here. It’s evidence of your hands, your time, your life — pressed into steel. It’s not purchased; it’s made. And that changes everything. When you’re gone, they’re going to sell your house. They’re going to auction your cars. They’re going to pawn your Rolex. But they’ll fight over the Mission Timer you built. No other American watch company can do what we do. So if you’ve ever felt the pull to make something real, this is the place you cross the threshold. Come make something worth fighting over. Availability for 2026. We don’t do this often, and we don’t do this for everyone. ARES is a working shop first — a place where steel is cut, parts are made, and real production happens every day. Opening the doors for the Founder Build Experience isn’t a product decision. It’s a commitment of time, tools, focus, and hands-on guidance. Because of that, we offer only 7 Founder's Dates in 2026. Not classes. Not sessions. Weekends. One at a time. Small, personal, founder-led. Most years, only a handful of people will ever stand at these machines and make their own Mission Timer. The rest of the world will keep buying watches in glass cases from sales counters under mall lighting. You’re choosing something different. If you see a date available, take it. When the calendar fills, the door closes until the following year. We don’t oversell spots. We don’t expand capacity to chase demand. We keep it small on purpose — to protect the craft, the experience, and the story you walk out with. This is the one watch in your life you won’t regret making time for. Thursday Evening – Arrival & Reception You arrive in Stanwood at ARES HQ and step straight into the ARES community. Whiskey & Watches reception Meet Matt and the local ARES crew Food, fellowship, and stories Shop walkthrough Safety briefing Watch configuration and material selection This isn’t a warm-up — this is where you cross from the outside world into the maker’s world. Friday – Machining the Heart of Your Timer This is the day steel becomes purpose. THE LATHE Cut your raw steel into the beginnings of your Mission Timer case. THE MILL Drill, profile, and machine your geometry on our Haas VF-1 — the same machine that cuts every ARES we make. THE BLAST TANK Texture your case by hand and bring the surface to life. Every cut guided. Every decision yours. Saturday – Finishing, Dial Work & Assembly This is where your timer becomes a reflection of you. CERAKOTE BOOTH Apply your chosen finish under direct supervision. DIAL STATION Personalize your dial — print, apply, or refine your variant. ASSEMBLY BENCH Set your movement. Press your hands. Seat your stem and crown. Seal and torque your caseback. Build your timer from the inside out. You’re no longer watching a watch being made. You’re making one. LUNCH A closing meal with the ARES team before heading home, wearing the Mission Timer you built with your own hands. PRESSURE TEST Depth testing and verification — the same standard every ARES must pass. FINAL INSPECTION You approve your own work. You sign your QC card. You engrave your caseback with your serial number. You take your first wrist shot. The final steps before you return home with something no one else on earth has. Guaranteed for life. AVAILABILITY These are the only available Founder Build Weekends for 2026. Small. Personal. Founder-led. If you see a date available, take it. We will contact you directly regarding scheduling and travel information. Full payment required at booking. Non-refundable. Transferable with 60 days’ notice. Travel and lodging no

watches.name: GMT Global Mission Timer®
watches.description: You're three time zones from everyone you love. What time is it at home? That's the only question a GMT exists to answer — and ours answers it for fifty hours on a wind, at 100ATM, for life. Built how? ↓ The ARES® GMT Global Mission Timer™ is a hand-crafted precision time piece that gives you the best of both worlds: with multiple timezone references the GMT allows you to be present, even while away. And with the ARES® Limited Lifetime Guarantee, each U.S. hand-crafted timepiece is guaranteed to give you the one thing you want more of: time. The GMT follows the same design parameters of the DIVER-1: reliability, dependability, legibility, and longevity. The reliability of the GMT is in the ARES ETA 2893-2 automatic movement, a robust 40-hour power reserve Swiss-made hand crafted movement. The dependability of the GMT comes from the tried & tested 316L stainless steel case and solid caseback with sapphire front. The GMT, with its beautiful movement and display-back case, is built for adversity with its CERTIFIED 1000M/100ATM depth rating. Carrying over the lume from the standard DIVER-1, the GMT features the same 5-layer application of Swiss C-3 SuperLumiNova: the industry standard in legibility, regardless of environment. And the GMT is backed by one of the strongest Warranties in the industry: Lifetime on the the case construction and a full 5 year Limited Warranty on the ARES ETA movement - which includes one complimentary service. The Ares GMT is a hand-crafted and hand-finished precision timer and are built to order. This process can take up to 5-8 weeks, or longer. All GMT’s are shipped complimentary via FEDEX/UPS 2-day shipping. SPECIFICATIONS: 41mm x 49.5mm x 14mm stainless steel two piece case with individually serialized, engraved, screwback construction, in either bead blasted or Deep Black PVD 42.0mm 316L stainless steel bead blasted bezel, featuring countdown timer with C3 Superluminova, clear coat finish, aggressive ‘no slip’ teeth, and 120-click uni-directional countdown mission timer 49.5mm lug to lug 22mm drilled lugs with 1.8mm shoulderless spring bars, supplied with matching straps: (1) each ARES Mission Timer rubber strap in Deep Black with matching finish Every GMT ships on rubber.
